label: TP
reason: User-controlled input 'bar' flows directly into XPath expression construction via string concatenation ('/' + bar + ']') at line 85 without effective sanitization. The ESAPI.encodeForHTML() call only executes in the catch block (line 86) for error display, not during XPath compilation. The XXE prevention setting (disallow-doctype-decl=true) mitigates XXE attacks but does not prevent XPath injection where user input becomes part of the XPath syntax.

evidence.note: User input 'bar' concatenated into XPath expression '/Employees/Employee[@emplid=' + bar + "]' without proper validation
